opening.argument: The presenter promotes a paid sniper bot that automatically buys tokens during launches, directs interested viewers to its link, and expressly urges them to purchase through the linked shop. The offer is displayed as a “SNIPER BOT (Binance Smart Chain)” priced at $200.00 with a Purchase button. More seriously, the setup instructs users to enter their wallet’s private key into the bot: “you put and the private key.” That creates a direct account-control risk beyond an ordinary trading tutorial. The promotion also claims, “It will allow to do x2 or x3 more than if you got in manually,” encouraging participation through an easy-profit representation rather than a cautious description of trading risks.
